Safety Information
•	
Ensure to mount and assemble all the components before adjusting the position, rotation, and tilt 
of your monitor arm. Movement should be smooth and easy through the full range of motion and 
the monitor arm should stay in place once set. If this is not the case, double check that you have 
followed the adjustment instructions.
•	
Whenever equipment is added or removed from your monitor arm, leading to a change in the 
weight of the mounted load, repeat the adjustments steps to ensure safe and optimal operation.
•	
Ensure your mounting surface is strong and wide enough to support the monitor arm and 
mounted equipment.
•	
Ensure the connected cables have sufficient slack to accommodate the full range of motion.
•	
Ensure the connected cables are properly routed to avoid cable pinching. Cable pinching may 
cause damages to the monitor arm or personal injuries.
•	
DO NOT exceed the listed maximum weight capacity as this may cause damages to the monitor 
arm and mounted equipment or personal injuries.
 WARNING
DO NOT remove mounted equipment from the monitor arm unless the monitor 
arm has been moved to the highest position. The monitor arm may rapidly 
move upwards when mounted equipment is removed, due to tension in the 
arm mechanism. This may cause severe personal injuries and damages to the 
equipment.

I want to convert the ROG STRIX OLED XG27ACDNG from its original stand to the ROG ERGO MONITOR ARM (AAS01). The desk thickness is known to be 62 mm. Please determine whether this combination is compatible and provide a minimal executable installation plan: at least explain 1) whether the dimensions, weight, and VESA compatibility are met; 2) which thickness range should be selected for the desk mount; 3) what disassembly action must be performed on the monitor first; 4) at least two mandatory safety precautions.

rubrics: 1. Does the answer clearly determine that the monitor is compatible with the AAS01 and simultaneously provide the three justifications based on dimensions, weight, and 100 x 100 mm VESA?
2. Does the answer correctly select the 40-80 mm mounting range for the 62 mm desk?
3. Does the answer indicate that before installation, the monitor's original stand/base must be removed by pressing the release button, and then the VESA mount should be installed?

4. Does the answer provide at least two correct safety requirements from the manual, such as desk load-bearing capacity, C-clamp must be flush against the edge, adjust only after installation is complete, leave slack in cables and avoid pinching, and do not overload?

Please determine whether this combination is compatible and provide a minimal executable installation plan: at least explain 1) whether the dimensions, weight, and VESA compatibility are met; 2) which thickness range should be selected for the desk mount; 3) what disassembly action must be performed on the monitor first; 4) at least two mandatory safety precautions.

After installation, I connected the host to the monitor via HDMI, but the power LED is red and there is no display; at the same time, plugging a keyboard into the USB Type-A port on the back of the monitor also yields no response. Based solely on the manual, provide troubleshooting steps sorted by priority. What additional cable is required for the USB hub to work?

rubrics: 1. Does the answer include confirming that both the monitor and the computer are powered on, and checking whether the power cord connection is normal?
2. Does the answer require checking the HDMI/signal cable connection status and inspecting the cable pins for bending?
3. Does the answer include a troubleshooting step of using another available monitor to verify whether the computer is working normally?
4. Does the answer correctly state that the USB hub requires an additional USB upstream cable?
